settings.title: Block client ads
settings.summary: Decline native client ads. Server-stitched stream ads may still play.

settings.title: Block cookie notice
settings.summary: Hide the automatic notice without accepting consent. Manual consent settings remain available.

settings.title: Block display ads
settings.summary: Stream display, audio, headliner and feed ads, and brand surveys. Stitched stream ads still play.

settings.title: Clean share links
settings.summary: Removes known tracking parameters from Twitch links you share or copy; keeps functional parameters.

settings.title: Disable analytics
settings.summary: Stops Spade, Nielsen and Sprig, limits Branch tracking, denies SDK consent, disables Crashlytics uploads and Sentry. Watch progress/rewards may be affected.

settings.title: Watch without signing in
settings.summary: Skip the Log In / Sign Up screen while signed out. Account actions still ask you to sign in.

settings.title: AMOLED black
settings.summary: Black instead of dark grey in the dark theme, on screens drawn with Android views. Compose screens and pop-up sheets stay dark grey.

settings.title: Default startup tab
settings.summary: The screen Twitch opens on. Following needs an account.

settings.title: Fix notifications
settings.summary: Register for push notifications with Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, which Firebase requires.

settings.title: Fix stuck start screen
settings.summary: Open Twitch when its start screen is still waiting for Branch's link lookup after 5 seconds.

settings.title: Hide Bits tipping
settings.summary: Bits purchase buttons and cheering prompts. Received cheers still appear.

settings.title: Hide Cast button
settings.summary: The player's Chromecast button.

settings.title: Hide Clip button
settings.summary: The player's Create Clip button.

settings.title: Hide Clips
settings.summary: Clips discovery on Home and the native channel profile tab. Shared links still open.

settings.title: Hide Continue watching
settings.summary: Videos to resume, in Following and the Home feed.

settings.title: Hide Hype Train
settings.summary: The Hype Train banner above chat and on the player, and its reward pop-ups.

settings.title: Hide Share button
settings.summary: The player's Share button.

settings.title: Hide Stories
settings.summary: The Stories button and shelf at the top of Home.

settings.title: Hide celebrations
settings.summary: Full-screen celebration animations over the video.

settings.title: Hide leaderboards
settings.summary: The Bits, gift and clip leaderboards above chat.

settings.title: Hide mature content warning
settings.summary: Skip the content-label warning on streams, videos and clips. Age and region restrictions still apply.

settings.title: Hide offline channels
settings.summary: Followed channels that aren't live, in Following.

settings.title: Hide pinned cheers
settings.summary: Paid messages pinned above chat.

settings.title: Hide recommended channels
settings.summary: Recommended live channels in Following.

settings.title: Hide sub and gift messages
settings.summary: Other viewers' subscription, resub and gifted-sub messages in chat (including the text they add to a resub), and gift banners above chat.

settings.title: Hide subscription upsells
settings.summary: Subscribe, gifting and Turbo promotions. Keeps subscribed status.

settings.title: Hide watch streaks
settings.summary: Watch-streak pop-ups and other viewers' watch-streak messages in chat.

settings.title: Navigation bar
settings.summary: Where the main screen's navigation bar sits, and whether its icons have labels.

settings.title: Tablet layout
settings.summary: Twitch's tablet interface on this phone: Home and the player rotate, chat sits beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail replaces the bottom bar in landscape.

settings.title: Navigation rail in portrait
settings.summary: Keep the navigation rail when the phone is upright too. Signed in, Twitch opens its Following sidebar next to the rail, which covers most of the screen until it's closed.

settings.title: Avoid stitched ads
settings.summary: During a stitched ad break, play the stream at up to 360p from a picture-by-picture session, which has no ads. Applies to streams started after it's turned on; turned off, a break in progress finishes first. Not for streams loaded through Playlist proxy.

settings.title: Background audio
settings.summary: Default for Twitch's "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" until you pick one in Twitch's settings.

settings.title: Brightness and volume swipes
settings.summary: In landscape, swipe up or down on the left of the video for brightness and on the right for volume. The middle keeps drag to minimize.

settings.title: Clip download
settings.summary: Adds "Download clip" to a clip's menu (⋮) in the clips feed. Asks gql.twitch.tv for the clip's video with the app's Client-ID only and saves it to Downloads/Twitch.

settings.title: Default video quality
settings.summary: Used until a player quality is saved. Missing renditions use Twitch's fallback.

settings.title: On mobile data
settings.summary: Used instead of the default on metered networks (mobile data, or Wi-Fi marked as metered) when it is lower. Like the default, only until a player quality is saved.

settings.title: Fill screen
settings.summary: Zoom streams and videos to fill the screen in landscape instead of showing bars at the sides, the strip beside the camera included, cropping their top and bottom. Not for vertical videos, next to the chat or in picture-in-picture.

settings.title: Force ExoPlayer
settings.summary: Play live channels and videos with ExoPlayer instead of Amazon IVS. Applies to the next stream or video you open. Lurk's IVS player options don't act on ExoPlayer.

settings.title: Force landscape
settings.summary: Turn to landscape when a live stream or video opens in the theatre, and back when it closes. Applies to players opened after it's turned on.

settings.title: Latency badge
settings.summary: Shows how far a live stream is behind the broadcast on the player. Tap it to reload the stream at the live edge (a new access token and playlist, as Twitch's Retry). Applies to players opened after it's turned on.

settings.title: Mute stitched ads
settings.summary: Mute and black out ad breaks stitched into streams. The ad still plays for its full length.

settings.title: No autoplay of the next video
settings.summary: Stops recommendation countdowns and automatic feed clip advancement. Manual Play still works.

settings.title: No feed autoplay
settings.summary: Defaults to Never until you choose another option in Twitch's autoplay setting.

settings.title: Normal latency
settings.summary: Turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers. Applies to streams opened afterwards.

settings.title: Refresh stream
settings.summary: Long-press the player's settings gear to reload a stuck stream with a new access token, as Twitch's Retry does. Applies to players opened after it's turned on.

settings.title: Also by long-pressing the video
settings.summary: Long-press the middle of the video to refresh too. Twitch doesn't use this gesture.

settings.title: Show video stats
settings.summary: A stats button in the player: latency, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames and a live stream's uptime.

settings.title: Sleep timer
settings.summary: Pauses playback this long after it last started or resumed, including background audio.

settings.title: Use native player
settings.summary: Open live channels in the native player, which most Lurk patches act on.

settings.title: VOD chapters
settings.summary: Adds a Chapters button to the video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one. One request to Twitch per video loaded, previews included, without your account.

settings.title: VOD skip interval
settings.summary: Rewind and forward on videos and in the media notification. Other intervals use icons without Twitch's 10 and 30.

settings.title: 7TV emotes
settings.summary: Shows 7TV emotes in chat. Sends the ID of the channel you watch to 7tv.io and loads images from cdn.7tv.app.

settings.title: Anonymous chat
settings.summary: Read chat as a guest so you aren't listed as a chatter. Sending messages is disabled while this is on.

settings.title: Auto-claim Drops
settings.summary: Claim a Drop for your account as soon as the channel's drops notification shows it as claimable. Needs a signed-in account.

settings.title: Auto-claim channel points
settings.summary: Claim the bonus chest for your account as soon as it appears in chat.

settings.title: BetterTTV emotes
settings.summary: Shows BetterTTV emotes in chat. Sends the ID of the channel you watch to api.betterttv.net and loads images from cdn.betterttv.net.

settings.title: Chat appearance
settings.summary: Use the chat look chosen below. Off, or with every choice at Twitch's default, chat looks as in Twitch.

settings.title: Chat text size
settings.summary: Live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay.

settings.title: Emote size
settings.summary: Twitch's and third-party emotes in native chat, chat history and VOD chat replay. Larger sizes load Twitch's larger emote images.

settings.title: Badge size
settings.summary: Twitch's and third-party badges in native chat, chat history and VOD chat replay.

settings.title: Message spacing
settings.summary: Space above and below each message in native chat, chat history and VOD chat replay.

settings.title: Alternating row backgrounds
settings.summary: Shade every other chat message.

settings.title: /me messages
settings.summary: How messages sent with /me look.

settings.title: Landscape chat width
settings.summary: Share of the screen width taken by the chat panel in landscape. Applies when the player is next laid out.

settings.title: Landscape chat background
settings.summary: Opacity of the landscape chat panel's background, over the video or the player's black background.

settings.title: Chat keywords
settings.summary: Highlight and hide chat messages by the words and users below, in live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay. Whole words, any case.

settings.title: Highlight mentions
settings.summary: Tint messages that mention your username. Needs a signed-in account.

settings.title: Highlight words
settings.summary: Tint messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Vibrate on highlights
settings.summary: Vibrate when a highlighted message arrives in live chat.

settings.title: Blocked words
settings.summary: Hide messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Blocked users
settings.summary: Hide messages from these usernames (logins, as in twitch.tv/name), separated by commas.

settings.title: Chat overlay
settings.summary: In landscape, live chat messages scroll across the top of the video. Native live channels only; touches still reach the player.

settings.title: Chat overlay lines
settings.summary: How many lines of messages scroll at once.

settings.title: Chat overlay speed
settings.summary: How fast messages cross the video.

settings.title: Chat timestamps
settings.summary: The time in front of each chat message.

settings.title: Chatterino badges
settings.summary: Shows Chatterino supporter and contributor badges in chat. Downloads Chatterino's list of badge holders from api.chatterino.com and the badge images from the https hosts that list names (fourtf.com today).

settings.title: Emote and badge info
settings.summary: Tap an emote or a badge in chat to see its name, a larger image and where it comes from, with a button that copies the name. Signed in, Twitch emotes keep Twitch's own emote card.

settings.title: Emotes as text
settings.summary: Shows emotes in native chat as their text, without loading their images.

settings.title: Emotes in the picker
settings.summary: Lists the emotes of the services turned on above in the emote picker, one section each, and in autocomplete after ':'. Uses the lists chat already loads and sends nothing else.

settings.title: FrankerFaceZ badges
settings.summary: Shows FrankerFaceZ supporter, developer and bot badges in chat. Downloads FrankerFaceZ's list of badge holders from api.frankerfacez.com and the badge images from cdn.frankerfacez.com.

settings.title: FrankerFaceZ emotes
settings.summary: Shows FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat. Sends the ID of the channel you watch to api.frankerfacez.com and loads images from cdn.frankerfacez.com.

settings.title: Hide badges
settings.summary: Leaves chatters' badges out of native chat lines, Twitch's and third-party ones.

settings.title: Highlight first-time chatters
settings.summary: Tints a chatter's first message in the channel green in native live chat, as Twitch's chat server marks it.

settings.title: Ignore chat clears
settings.summary: Keep the messages when a moderator clears the chat. Timeouts and bans still apply.

settings.title: Pronouns
settings.summary: Shows chatters' pronouns from pronouns.alejo.io as a badge. Sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io (answers are kept for an hour).

settings.title: Show deleted messages
settings.summary: Keep deleted messages, struck through, instead of "message deleted".

settings.title: Debug logging
settings.summary: Detailed lines in the system log for bug reports (adb logcat -s lurk). They can name the channels and videos you open.
